items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: there was this criticism that Django is not really a jazz player

ctx.x: Passion. Fire. Brilliance. Absolutely just brilliant. There is no other word for it. I mean just how anybody could play that way. Again I mean even when I went to school there was this criticism that Django is not really a jazz player. He had so much of the gypsy fire and the certain kind of scaler thing that he would do and just the way he would play, he didn’t sound like Charlie Christian. But to me it was still jazz. And I think that was one of the early experiences of hearing someone play who wasn’t coming…
